problem: Run documents and the log. The spec shape is untouched. launch.json changes almost entirely; the tests map gains a verdict field; the plan loses gates and ceilings and gains a scout flag; events lose phase and gain run; evidence and check results stay; RUNLOG.md becomes FLIGHTLOG.md with the same diagnosis fields. You said: just write the test and let the test-builder reshape it after the core spec freezes.

questions.text: For a document whose shape changes, what does the suite pin now?
questions.why: Pinning the whole current shape gives the test-builder a complete test to reshape; pinning only survivors gives it less to undo but leaves today's document half-described.

options.value: The whole current shape: a conforming and a refused document per schema as it stands today; the test-builder reshapes on its turn.
Only the invariants that survive: contiguous ids, frozen status, baseline recorded, fill markers, one evidence file per check.

questions.text: Is the run log's contract a kept behaviour: an entry per run with the human's diagnosis fields (seen on, cause, fixed on, change, watch, kept, promote), a symptom pre-filled and never hand-written, and no new run opening while a fill line stands?
questions.why: The file is renamed and the entry is written by a role instead of a command, but the fields and the blocking rule are the method's, not the runner's.

options.value: Kept: pin the entry fields and the blocking rule against RUNLOG.md as it is today.
Not kept: the log is redesigned with the layout; leave it out.
